title: Challenges in Annotating Datasets to Quantify Bias in Under-represented Society
reasoning: The paper discusses in depth the challenges of defining and quantifying bias, which involve subjective moral judgments related to social status, stereotypes, and criminal activity, directly impacting the ethical soundness of their annotation scheme. The 'Ethical Statement' section also provides a substantial discussion about the sensitive nature of the data and the ethical reasons for not releasing the dataset, indicating a deep integration of ethical considerations within the research challenges and outcomes.
